title: Creature
description: A monster/NPC-style SF2E stat block (GM Core creature-building rules), as distinct from a full PC build (see common/sf2e-common.schema.json#/$defs/pcStatblock, used by kid/frame). Reusable for Claimant instances (data/antagonists/claimants/) and any other creature that needs combat stats but isn't a PC. One file per creature.
